purpose: Act as the hard quality gate between CSD-008 perception resolution and downstream CSD-002 storyboard/visual production.
core_principle: A perception is production-ready only when it is causally supported, information-valid, physically plausible, emotionally coherent, continuity-safe and meaningfully distinct from other perspectives while remaining inside one canonical reality.

quality_dimensions.reality_integrity: All characters perceive the same underlying physical events and world state.
quality_dimensions.information_integrity: Each perception uses only information legitimately available to its character.
quality_dimensions.causal_integrity: Attention and interpretation are explainable from objective, emotion, knowledge and relationship state.
quality_dimensions.sensory_integrity: Perceived details are accessible through established sight, sound, proximity, timing or other valid sensory channels.
quality_dimensions.temporal_integrity: No state or knowledge from a later narrative point is imported early.
quality_dimensions.interpretive_integrity: Subjective meaning remains distinguishable from observable evidence.
quality_dimensions.continuity_integrity: Character identity, emotional carryover, relationships and world state remain consistent.
quality_dimensions.perspective_differentiation: Different POVs produce meaningful differences in attention or interpretation rather than cosmetic camera changes.
quality_dimensions.audience_integrity: Audience-only information is explicitly controlled and never silently assigned to a character.
quality_dimensions.production_readiness: The result contains enough deterministic information for CSD-002 frame direction.

scoring_model.pass_rule: All hard gates pass; advisory observations may remain open.
scoring_model.no_score_claim: This engine does not rank characters or scenes; it determines production validity.

output.validation_fingerprint: stable digest input for downstream lineage

deterministic_rules: Every perception must map to at least one valid emotional, informational, objective or relational cause.
Every perceived external detail must have sensory access or explicit scene evidence.
Every interpretation must be marked as interpretation, belief or inference.
Unknown and withheld information must remain unavailable.
One canonical event may have multiple interpretations but never multiple incompatible physical occurrences.
At least two meaningful perspective dimensions must differ across distinct character POVs when multiple POV characters are used.
All eight frame directives must resolve to valid perspective assignments.
CSD-006 emotional state and CSD-007 information state are mandatory upstream dependencies.
A failed hard gate blocks downstream visual promotion.

canonical_reality: Hanuman remains ready but does not intervene

constraints: Do not expose unknown information through dialogue or reaction
Keep Ravan's introspection visible only through supported performance cues
Preserve Rama's composure and Hanuman's latent readiness
